name: Zendesk
summary: Customer service platform (ticketing, messaging, voice, help center) with Zendesk AI: AI agents that resolve customer requests across channels without a person, Copilot for human agents, and AutoQA, which scores every interaction. For agents calling in, the vendor publishes the REST API (OAuth access tokens; API tokens deprecated) and an AI Agents API keyed per organization, and documents no MCP server. Measured 2026-10-11: every *.zendesk.com host answers /api/mcp with an OAuth challenge and advertises dynamic client registration, undocumented. The API answers an anonymous end user.

agentAccess.notes: No credentials, 2026-09-24 12:06Z: GET support.zendesk.com/api/v2/users/me.json 200, "Anonymous user"; help-centre search 200. 2026-10-11 12:04Z: POST /api/mcp on any *.zendesk.com host, 401 with an RFC 9728 challenge; the OAuth metadata advertises PKCE and dynamic registration. Undocumented.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-24: nothing prices a call or speaks a 402. Three of four Customer Service plans carry a number, $19/$55/$115 agent/month paid yearly; the fourth says "Talk to Sales". Card at self-serve checkout, invoice sales-assisted only. AI-agent usage meters per resolution, price unpublished.

jobs.summary: Zendesk AI agents, the vendor's words on this page: "Resolve multi-step, multi-intent requests across channels with AI agents that understand intent, ask clarifying questions, and take action across systems"; "complete requests without handoffs"; "resolving requests autonomously". Not measured.

AutoQA, the vendor's words on this page: "Let AI powered QA review every interaction, whether handled by a human or AI agent"; "AutoQA scores the quality of all interactions, including AI agents and voice". Agreement with a trained reviewer's score is not stated. Not measured.
